description: Fixed lexical evaluation set for cited-passage support. This checks whether retrieved passages contain the facts an answer would need; it is not an LLM-as-judge and does not score generation quality.

cases.question: Where should compatible GGUF models be stored in the workspace?
cases.content: The models folder holds compatible .gguf files. Never commit model weights. Runtime binaries live under runtime/<platform>/ and conversations are stored in data/.

cases.question: Does the application API listen on the local loopback interface?
cases.content: Browser requests go to an authenticated loopback-only API. The application owns one llama-server child on a separate loopback port. No permissive CORS header is sent.

cases.question: Is MyAi proven faster than PortableLM?
cases.content: No speed or quality superiority claim is currently supported by measurements. Compare using identical computer, model, quantization, context and prompts, and record raw results.
